meta.note: Top-8 target markets from the Comtrade-grounded ranking. Iraq is the flagship (Iran already ~57% of imports, +74% YoY, 1-3 truck-days). 20 buyers posted a 2025+ honey RFQ (14 confirmed) - Pakistan 7, Qatar 6, UAE 5; plus 95 rated potential importers/distributors. Iraq/Afghanistan/Armenia/Kazakhstan trade is mostly informal/land so they lean Tier-2 (direct-approach importers). Gulf monarchies (Saudi/Kuwait/Bahrain/Oman) are demand-rich but currently blocked on Iran-linked banking (2025-26 snapback) - excluded on purpose.
